title: Validate successful LTE attach and detach of a single UE under excellent radio conditions
preconditions: Single cell scenario with all other cells powered off
UE placed under excellent LTE radio conditions (RSRP as per Clause 4.6)
Test configuration parameters recorded and applied
End-to-end LTE setup operational without connectivity issues
testSteps: Configure test setup according to the test configuration
Place the UE (real or emulated) under excellent LTE radio conditions near the cell center
Start logs to capture call flow and signaling messages
Power ON the UE to initiate LTE attach procedure
Wait for successful attach indication (attach request and attach accept messages)
Verify UE is attached to the correct LTE cell (check PCI, Global eNB ID, ARFCN in UE logs)
Power OFF the UE to initiate LTE detach procedure
Wait for successful detach indication (detach request and detach accept messages and UE context release)
Stop and save test logs
Repeat attach-detach procedure 10 times consecutively and record attach and detach success rate and attach latency
expectedResults: Attach success rate = 100% (all 10 attempts successful)
Detach success rate = 100% (all 10 attempts successful)
Attach latency measured and recorded with minimum, average, and maximum values
UE correctly attached to the specified LTE cell in all iterations
No connectivity issues during attach-detach procedures
verificationMethods: Analyze UE logs for attach and detach message flows
Validate KPIs recorded in test report (attach success rate, detach success rate, latency)
Verify radio parameters RSRP, RSRQ meet excellent conditions

title: Validate successful 5G NSA attach and detach with secondary node addition and release
preconditions: Single isolated cell scenario with other cells powered off
UE placed under excellent 5G NSA radio conditions (5G SS-RSRP as per Clause 4.6)
Test configuration parameters recorded and applied
End-to-end 5G NSA setup operational without connectivity issues
testSteps: Configure test setup according to the test configuration
Place the UE (real or emulated) under excellent 5G NSA radio conditions near the cell center
Start logs to capture signaling and call flow messages
Power ON the UE to initiate 5G NSA attach procedure
Wait for successful LTE initial attach and secondary node addition (validate attach request/accept and SgNB addition request/complete messages)
Verify UE is attached to correct LTE and NR cells (check PCI, Global eNB ID/gNB ID, ARFCN/NR-ARFCN in UE logs)
Power OFF the UE to initiate 5G NSA detach procedure
Wait for successful LTE detach and secondary node release (validate detach request/accept and SgNB release request/acknowledge messages)
Stop and save test logs
Repeat attach-detach procedure 10 times consecutively and record attach success rate, secondary node addition success rate, and detach success rate
expectedResults: Attach success rate = 100% (all 10 attempts successful)
Secondary node addition success rate = 100%
Detach success rate = 100% (all 10 attempts successful)
UE correctly attached to the specified LTE and NR cells in all iterations
No connectivity issues during attach-detach procedures
verificationMethods: Analyze UE logs and network traces for attach, secondary node addition, detach, and secondary node release message flows
Validate KPIs recorded in test report (attach success rate, secondary node addition success rate, detach success rate)
Verify radio parameters 5G SS-RSRP, RSRQ meet excellent conditions

title: Negative test for attach failure due to poor radio conditions below minimum coupling loss
preconditions: Single cell scenario with UE placed under poor radio conditions (RSRP or 5G SS-RSRP below minimum coupling loss as per Clause 4.6)
Test configuration recorded
testSteps: Configure test setup according to the test configuration
Place the UE under poor radio conditions below minimum coupling loss
Start logs to capture signaling messages
Power ON the UE to initiate attach procedure
Wait for attach failure indication or timeout
Power OFF the UE to attempt detach procedure
Stop and save test logs
expectedResults: Attach fails due to poor radio conditions
Attach success rate is 0%
Detach procedure either not initiated or fails gracefully
Logs show attach request retransmissions or no response
No unexpected UE behavior or system crashes
verificationMethods: Analyze logs for attach failure messages or timeouts
Check that UE does not attach to any cell
Validate system handles failure gracefully

title: Negative test for detach failure due to signaling interruption
preconditions: Single cell scenario with UE under excellent radio conditions
Test configuration recorded
Network signaling interruption simulated during detach
testSteps: Configure test setup according to the test configuration
Place the UE under excellent radio conditions
Power ON the UE and perform successful attach
Simulate signaling interruption or message loss during detach procedure
Power OFF the UE to initiate detach
Observe detach message flow and failure handling
Stop and save logs
expectedResults: Detach request or accept messages fail to complete
Detach success rate is less than 100%
UE either retries detach or recovers gracefully
Logs capture error or timeout events related to detach
No system crashes or deadlocks
verificationMethods: Analyze logs for detach message failures
Check system behavior on failed detach
Validate retries or recovery mechanisms

testSteps: Configure test setup according to the test configuration

Start logs for detailed timing and signaling capture
Power ON the UE and wait for successful attach
Power OFF the UE and wait for successful detach

Record attach success rate, detach success rate, and latency values
Sort latency values and record minimum, average, and maximum as per Table 5-3
expectedResults: Attach and detach success rate = 100%

title: Security test: Verify authentication and authorization during attach for LTE and 5G NSA
preconditions: Single cell setup operational
UE configured with valid credentials and security keys
testSteps: Power ON the UE to initiate attach procedure
Capture authentication and authorization signaling messages
Verify authentication challenge and response sequences
Ensure only authorized UE is allowed to attach
Attempt attach with invalid credentials (negative case)
Verify attach rejection and security logs
expectedResults: Authentication and authorization succeed for valid UE
Attach procedure completes only after successful authentication
Attach rejected for invalid credentials with proper error messages
No unauthorized attach allowed
verificationMethods: Analyze authentication signaling messages
Check security logs for successful/failed authentication events
Verify attach accept/reject behavior

title: Integration test: Validate coordination between MN and SN during secondary node release (5G NSA detach)
preconditions: 5G NSA setup with MN and SN configured
UE attached with active secondary node
testSteps: Power OFF the UE to initiate detach procedure
Observe MN initiated secondary node release procedure
Verify MN sends SgNB Release Request message to SN
Verify SN sends SgNB Release Request Acknowledge message
Check MN sends RRCConnectionReconfiguration message to UE to release SCG configuration
Verify SN sends SN Status Transfer and Secondary RAT Data Usage Report messages to MN
Confirm SN releases UE context upon UE Context Release message
Alternatively, simulate SN initiated secondary node release and verify message flows accordingly
expectedResults: MN and SN coordinate secondary node release as per 3GPP TS 37.340 Clause 10.4.1
All relevant signaling messages exchanged successfully
UE releases secondary node configuration properly
No signaling failures or resource leaks
verificationMethods: Analyze signaling traces between MN, SN, and UE
Verify message sequence diagrams conform to standard
Check resource release and data forwarding coordination

expectedResults: Test setup and execution steps are clear and unambiguous
